scientific_scope.rationale: The older trajectory adapter distinguished the INIT reference anchor from the DEC measured state. The absolute-world-endpoint initialization recipe did not carry that simple compensation. This condition connects a fixed predecision correction to the new desired intent without tuning against future errors or weakening the baseline for a learned-model comparison.

entry.execution_route: The same CLI with --execute delegates to scripts.wm02.pilot1_native_worker and the original AUTO1/P1 admission, owner locks and native lifecycle.

first_predecessor.required_evidence: Exact CLOSED0 worker/spec join, 7103 integrations, all184 pose/gripper atoms, all40 knots, original safety, four clean child exits and zero dropped trace records; retain separate goal/readiness/hold-sample artifact hashes.

measurement_and_installation_chronology: Freeze the actual V2 static episode and its exact128-ramp/7103 endpoint before physics. It contains the correction rule and measurement step identities, not future measured bias values.
Obtain the original shared-loop ActualState TCP at INIT2503. Complete the unchanged prehold and stable decision-prefix checks.
At the actual3703 pause, join original ActualState FK, qpos/qvel/ctrl and TCP/cube poses to the exact original packet. Use only the current independent restart's INIT and DEC measurements.

Construct the same V1 desired goal and desired path algorithm at the same grade and clock: the frozen actual3703 cube plus the fixed world-Z140mm standoff, original source rotation and unchanged frame mapping. Equality of algorithms does not claim byte-identical restart observations or paths.

Freeze b=p_DEC-p_INIT in actual target-world components and C_R=R_INIT*transpose(R_DEC). Set reference_xyz=desired_xyz-b and reference_R=C_R*desired_R. The first reference remains exactly INIT; reference and desired endpoints generally differ.

Save and read back the packet, measured decision state and separate V2 goal binding, including b, C_R, source step/pose identities and both full-path hashes, before installing any generated reference.

Save both complete desired/reference paths in the original decision artifact. Validate each new typed full40 suffix, then retain the original native full-preview certifier, install ACK, source-relative TTL and actual pose/gripper consumption.

At the exact endpoint, retain original cancel/HOLD, trace seal and outer native shutdown audit. Save nine distinct actual complete samples from B-200 through B, read them back, then compute readiness from those samples. Readiness is not a native/GPU grant and a .03 grade cannot qualify full-grade query readiness.

fixed_math_and_limits.generic_operational_caller: Only the known V1/V2 phase-kind pairs with the original SOURCE_MEMBERS superset are accepted.

related_validation.coverage: Same-input desired/goal/clock invariance; exact target-world XYZ and noncommuting SO3 correction; immutable frozen metadata and full suffixes; explicit V2 manifest versus pure ancestor math view; known operational caller and source-check retention; exact complete predecessor and failure injections; shared native lifecycle with durable preinstall calibration and nine real distinct synthetic samples; V1/older-route regression.
related_validation.independent_read_only_review: No confirmed first-use blocker in the frozen V2 implementation and narrow shared hooks.

broad_regression.exclusion: One unfinished independent physics-feedback prototype; it is not connected to this native route.

next: After the broad regression and immutable-source publication, register one fresh finite .03 initialization-calibration scope through the original mechanism. Measure actual desired/reference tracking, hold, safety, consumption and resource costs before considering a larger grade or a learned correction.
